rationale: Steven is building consumer AI agents with brain-inspired memory systems and a focus on private, local-first architecture, while Dylan is scaling AI-powered career guidance at Casey AI—both are applying LLM tooling to vertical consumer problems. Steven's technical depth in TypeScript/Rust and conviction around UI-first personal AI complements Dylan's hands-on understanding of edtech product-market fit and go-to-market from his Salesforce sales background and coaching experience, creating potential for strategic dialogue on how AI agents can solve domain-specific scaling problems.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Dylan Bryan — you're both building consumer AI products (personal agents vs. career guidance) and share TypeScript/JavaScript in your stacks; Dylan's GTM expertise and research into AI-powered coaching could inform how TinyHumans reaches users, while Steven's conviction on private, local-first AI might reshape how Casey thinks about deployment.
